mapper.select: select * from sys_user where user_name = #{userName} and del_flag = '0'
select r.role_key from sys_role r inner join sys_user_role ur on r.role_id = ur.role_id where ur.user_id = #{userId} and r.status = '0'

select distinct m.perms from sys_menu m inner join sys_role_menu rm on m.menu_id = rm.menu_id inner join sys_user_role ur on rm.role_id = ur.role_id where ur.user_id = #{userId} and m.status = '0' and m.perms is not null and m.perms != ''
